properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued September 12 at 12:38PM CDT until September 12 at 1:00PM CDT by NWS Tulsa OK
properties.description:
At 1237 PM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located 5 miles west of
Taft, moving southeast at 20 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations in or near the path include...
Taft...                           Boynton...
Choska...                         Jamesville...
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 12 at 12:32PM EDT by NWS Peachtree City GA
properties.description:
...The National Weather Service in Peachtree City GA has issued a
Flood Warning for the following rivers in Georgia...

Nickajack Creek at US 278 near Mableton affecting Cobb County.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is occurring.

* WHERE...Nickajack Creek at US 278 near Mableton.

* WHEN...From this afternoon until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 10.0 feet, Flood stage is reached. Minor flooding will
occur in the woodlands and the natural flood plain upstream and
downstream from the gage at Veterans Memorial Highway. Portions of
Nickajack Park will begin to flood around one mile upstream from
the gage.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 12:00 PM EDT Saturday the stage was 10.2 feet.
- Recent Activity...The maximum river stage in the 24 hours ending
at 12:00 PM EDT Saturday was 10.2 feet.
- Forecast...No forecast is available for this location.
- Flood stage is 10.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 10.2
feet on 12/30/2021.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Additional information is available at weather.gov/atlanta.

properties.areaDesc: Terrebonne Bay; Coastal Waters from Port Fourchon LA to Lower Atchafalaya River LA out 20 nm
properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 12 at 12:44PM CDT until September 12 at 2:15PM CDT by NWS New Orleans LA
properties.description:
SMWLIX

The National Weather Service in New Orleans has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Terrebonne Bay...
Coastal Waters from Port Fourchon LA to Lower Atchafalaya River LA
out 20 nm...

* Until 215 PM CDT.

* At 1244 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line from 9 NM west of Golden
Meadow to 6 NM southeast of Point Au Fer Island, or along a line
from 10 NM north of Timbalier Bay to 6 NM southeast of Point Au Fer
Island, moving southeast at 5 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts and wind gusts to 34 knots.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Isle Derniers, Terrebonne Bay, Caillou Bay, Timbalier Island and
Timbalier Bay.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
